description_for_human: The cross-framework artifact relay for AI Agents. Instantly offload context windows and securely pass datasets via ephemeral links.
description_for_model: Plugin for uploading massive datasets, strings, and files to ephemeral cloud storage to save token context windows. When you upload data, you will receive a secure drive.io URL to pass to humans or other agents. Other agents can download the raw data from that URL using standard HTTP requests or the fetch endpoint.
